standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a morphism from a scheme into a disjoint union of stacks as a disjoint union decomposition of the scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the end of the counted proof (source lines 5929-5933)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the lift to the coproduct into lifts indexed by the pieces of the decomposition.

core_obligations: Reduce to one morphism: the family is jointly surjective and each member is flat and locally of finite presentation, so the induced morphism from the coproduct of the members has the same properties, and the corresponding criterion for a single morphism applies (proof lines 5925-5928)

Decompose the covering: a morphism from a scheme to a coproduct amounts to a disjoint union decomposition of the scheme together with morphisms into the members, so the covering obtained for the coproduct may be refined to the covering asserted in the statement (proof lines 5929-5933)
proof_roadmap: 对 ∐_j X_j → X 用本章「满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ 有 fppf 局部提升」的引理（联合满射保证该态射满）。
概型到余积的态射就是「分解为若干片 + 各片映入对应成员」，把得到的 fppf 覆盖细分即得所要的 {U_{i,j} → U} 与 U_{i,j} → X_j。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms of finite presentation of algebraic stacks admits, for every object over a scheme, an fppf covering of that scheme together with lifts of the object into the members of the family (author lemma at source lines 5912-5922, label lemma-surjective-family-flat-locally-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 5924-5934) reduces the family to the single morphism from its coproduct, applies the corresponding criterion for one morphism, and decomposes the resulting covering along the decomposition of a scheme mapping to a coproduct (proof lines 5925-5933). The reduction to the coproduct and the decomposition of the covering are the content. H2.
